City of Encinitas
Special Housing Authority Meeting 5:00 p.m.
AGENDA
WEDNESDAY, MARCH 12, 2025 -
05:30 PM
p.m.
City of Encinitas - City Council Chambers
505 S. Vulcan Avenue
Encinitas, California 92024
Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council.
CALL TO ORDER/ROLL CALL
Encinitas Housing Authority members receive an independent stipend of $50 for convening the Housing Authority meetings pursuant to Housing Authority Resolution No. 94-04.
AGENDA ITEMS
H1.
Approval of the Minutes of the June 22, 2022, Special Meeting. Contact Person: Board Secretary Hollywood
Approve the Minutes.
2025-03-12 Item H01 Minutes of the June 22, 2022 Special Housing Authority Meeting
H2.
Public Hearing for consideration and adoption of the draft FY 2025-2029 Public Housing Agency Plan for the City of Encinitas Housing Authority. The action being considered by the City Council is exempt from the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) because it is not a "project" under Section 15378(b)(5) of CEQA Guidelines. The action involves an organizational or administrative activity of government that will not result in the direct or indirect physical change in the environment. Contact Person: Program Coordinator Photinos
Approve the draft FY 2025-29 Public Housing Agency (PHA) Plan and authorize the Encinitas Housing Authority Executive Director (City Manager) to submit the FY 2025-29 PHA Plan with the required civil rights and consolidated plan certifications to the U.S. Department of Housing and Urban Development (HUD).
2025-03-12 Item H02 Public Hearing FY 025-029 Public Housing Agency
ADJOURNMENT
Notice to the Public:
To ensure that the City meets your needs when addressing the City Council, all presentation materials which require the use of visual equipment need to be submitted to the City's IT Division at least 24 hours in advance of the meeting (except for appeal hearings where materials must be submitted 7 days in advance). This includes photographs, Microsoft Office documents (PowerPoint, Word, Excel). No CD's, DVD's, or USB thumb/flash drives will be accepted at the meeting. All materials must be in PC format and digital presentation items must be emailed to it-service-desk@encinitasca.gov . Please label all materials with the corresponding agenda item number. Should technical assistance be necessary, it will be available to presenters from 5:30 p.m. to 5:50 p.m. on the day of the meeting. Presentation of video/digital/photographs are considered part of the maximum time limit provided to speakers.
